candidates.desc: In an empty flat, a young woman folds a flat sheet of cardboard into a big box, packs a rolled blanket, mugs and a plant into it with her partner, closes the lid, carries it and stacks three boxes; her cat jumps on top of the pile.

In an old attic full of jars, a finger drags a clean stripe through the thick grey dust on a shelf and the hand comes up coated. A young man lifts an old suitcase and blows a huge cloud of dust off it into the sunbeams while his friend laughs and coughs.

A couple gasps in mock horror at a finger swiped through the dust on their shelf. They dust the whole flat with cloth and duster - picture frame, lampshade, door frame - get a dust cloud in the face, and finish with exaggerated thumbs up over the spotless shelves while the cat climbs in.

In an animated late-night diner, a waitress dunks a mop into a red bucket, wrings it out dripping, and mops the checkered floor between stacked chairs. She nearly slips on the wet tiles, catches herself, and finally leans on the mop admiring the shiny clean floor.
A man fills a white kitchen sink with water and dish soap until a huge foam mountain rises, then he and a woman wash dirty plates in it and finally the water drains away.

A woman with a microphone commentates like a sports announcer while a man shoots crumpled paper balls at a mini basketball hoop mounted above a teal trash can. He celebrates a made shot, then picks up the missed paper balls off the floor and drops them into the open can.

A couple washes a car caked in orange mud on their driveway: they hose it down, scrub the hood with foamy sponges while their dog trots around, then rinse off the suds. The car ends up shiny silver and they pose proudly beside it.

In a tiled bathroom, a cartoon-like ginger kitten in a pink t-shirt stands at a toilet holding a white plate smeared with red sauce. It dips the dirty plate into the toilet bowl, then reaches up with one paw and presses the flush button. Blue water swirls round the bowl and the kitten swishes the plate through it. At the end the kitten proudly puts a shining white plate on top of a tall stack of clean plates, with the dirty sauce-covered ones beside it.

A cartoon: a round white character leans over a lit candle that stands in a small grey metal bucket on a bed of straw in a stone cellar. It blows the candle out and the room goes dark, leaving only the bucket and the smoking candle in the gloom. The scene cuts to a bedroom where the same character lies asleep in bed under a blue duvet with a red cap on. A digital clock shows 6:10, four phones lie on the duvet and light up with alarms, and a framed poster on the wall reads WAKE UP. CHASE GOALS. REPEAT. The character sleeps on with its mouth open, drooling.

A man in a black t-shirt stands beside a white sports car parked on a road through dry golden hills at sunset. He lifts the front lid and leans in, then works over the bodywork with a grey microfibre cloth, wiping the paint in long strokes in close-up until it is spotless. Close shots follow of the wing mirror and of the rear spoiler rising, and then the car pulls away and drives off down the empty road into the low sun.

A motocross rider sits on a green dirt bike in a wet paddock, caked from helmet to boots in thick brown mud, so that the goggles and the whole suit are one solid brown crust. Two mechanics in team shirts and caps work on him with a pressure hose: one wipes the mud off the helmet with a cloth while the other kneels and blasts water over the rider's legs and the bike. Brown water runs off in sheets and the green bodywork of the bike appears clean again under the mud.

A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.

A young man in a grey sleeveless top works alone in a launderette in front of a row of big industrial washing machines. He shakes out a striped shirt, lays it flat on an ironing board and presses it with a heavy steam iron, then reaches for the next item beside a tall stack of folded, freshly washed clothes.

A white tiled kitchen floor is covered with a long line of muddy brown animal paw prints leading from the door across the room. An older man in a flat cap and braces dips a string mop into a grey bucket of water, wrings it out, and then pushes a flat mop over the prints. The tiles he has passed over come up white and clean again, until he stands at the far end of a spotless floor that reflects the window.

A young man in a grey sweatshirt and mint-green rubber gloves stands at a kitchen sink and works on a blackened cast-iron frying pan, rubbing it hard with a soapy steel-wool pad until foam covers it. He lifts a heavy sooty pot out of the sink and scours its round underside, grimacing with the effort. He then hauls a cast-iron grill pan with a ridged rack out of the water, sets it over the sink and scours the black bars of the rack with both hands, foam and grime running off into the basin.

A young woman stands at a kitchen sink and squeezes a white drop of dish soap from a blue-capped bottle onto a yellow-and-green sponge she holds over a large steel pan crusted with red tomato sauce. She scrubs the inside of the pan with the sponge under the running tap until foam covers the surface and the sauce washes away. She rinses the pan, then turns to the camera holding the clean, shining pan in one hand and the sponge in the other.

A young man in a grey vest and shorts works his way across a white-tiled outdoor terrace, pulling a brush on a long wooden handle over the tiles and pushing scattered dry leaves into a growing heap. Palm trees, a parked car and a street are visible behind him; he works in flip-flops and the wet tiles reflect his shadow.

Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.

A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.

In a sunny narrow courtyard between old ochre houses with peeling plaster and wooden shutters, washing hangs on lines strung across: striped towels, shirts, grey socks, a white sheet and, in the middle, a coral-pink bra hanging from a wooden peg. The wind flips the bra up over the line and it swings back down while the white sheet flutters. A peg falls and lands in a puddle on the wet cobbles below, near a bicycle in a doorway, a broom, a crate of bottles and red geraniums.

A living room the morning after a party. A young man in sunglasses, a white T-shirt, grey joggers and yellow rubber gloves mops the wooden floor, which is covered in confetti, streamers and party hats, while holding a full black bin bag in his other hand. He stops, lifts his sunglasses and looks around at the mess. Two young people are asleep on the sofa behind him, lampshades hang from the ceiling, and a woman stands by the doorway as sunlight comes through the window.

The small kitchen of a village hall. A young man in a white shirt and a loose tie laughs as he rinses dirty plates over a steel sink full of suds and hands them to a laughing bride in a white wedding dress and veil, with an apron over the dress, who dries them with a checked tea towel and puts them in the rack. A tall stack of dirty plates waits on the counter and a rack in front is full of clean plates and cutlery. Behind them chairs are stacked in the hall and guests walk past.

A launderette. A young man in a navy T-shirt and jeans, a grey sock on his shoulder, first takes a selfie in a mirror with his phone, then pulls jeans and a sweater out of an open washing machine into an overflowing basket. He takes the sock off his shoulder and looks at it. A pile of clothes, a red jumper and a tipped-over box of washing powder lie on the tiled floor. Behind him a row of machines spins clothes, two women fold a sheet together and a young person sleeps slumped on a bench.

A brightly lit launderette. A young man in a black velvet jacket over an open shirt, patterned turquoise swim shorts and flip-flops holds a laundry basket full of clothes against his hip. A grey sock falls out of it as he pulls out a grey piece of clothing, holds it to his face and then holds it up, looking straight ahead. Behind him a young woman in sports clothes pulls a white sheet out of a dryer, a ginger cat sits on the machines and a young man lies asleep on a bench under strip lights.

Looking up a narrow old street between tall ochre and pink houses with green wooden shutters and small iron balconies. A washing line stretched across the street holds a long row of women's underpants in soft pastel colours, lilac, pink, blue, mint, white and yellow, each pinned with pegs and swaying in the wind as they dry in the sun. The sky is pale and clear, and more houses continue down the lane.
